newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Deputy PM says economic recovery confirmed.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Deputy PM says economic recovery confirmed.

text.p: Latest data for the third quarter of 1996 proved that the Italian economy was recovering, Deputy Prime Minister Walter Veltroni said on Tuesday.
National statistics office Istat said earlier that GDP rose 0.7 percent year-on-year between July and September and 0.6 percent by comparison with the second quarter.

"The increase in GDP...in the third quarter of 1996 confirms that the Italian economy is on the road to recovery," Veltroni said in a statement. "However the data shows the need for supportive intervention to secure stronger economic growth."
The government last week announced incentives to encourage people to buy new cars in a bid to boost the depressed auto market. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
